basics.description: **Note:** Review the [Release Notes](https://github.com/jusso-dev/Bower/blob/main/Solutions/Bower/ReleaseNotes.md) before installing. The [Bower](https://github.com/jusso-dev/Bower) solution for Microsoft Sentinel packages replay-safe KQL parsers (`BowerSecurityEvents` and `BowerSecurityEventsOfType`), scheduled analytics rules (Windows Event Collector brute force, firewall denial bursts, beyond-tolerance late-arrival monitoring, OWASP ASVS application security detections, and collector/source health), threat-hunting and reconciliation queries, and an operations workbook for `BowerSecurity_CL`. All analytics rules are installed as templates and start disabled so operators can validate them against live workspace telemetry before enabling. **Data Connectors:** 1, **Parsers:** 2, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 10, **Hunting Queries:** 6

options.text: This solution installs the Bower Security Telemetry Bridge data connector guidance for BowerSecurity_CL. Deploy deploy/bicep/main.bicep or deploy/sentinel/azuredeploy.json to provision the table, DCE and DCR.
This solution installs the replay-safe KQL workspace functions BowerSecurityEvents and BowerSecurityEventsOfType.
BowerSecurityEvents - Replay-collapsed Bower security events
BowerSecurityEventsOfType - Replay-collapsed Bower events filtered by event types
This Microsoft Sentinel solution installs the Bower Security Operations and Pipeline Health workbook.

elements.name: workbook1
elements.label: Bower Security Operations and Pipeline Health

options.text: Monitors collector health, delivery delay, queue backlogs, replay ratios, security event volume, Privacy & Secret Protection Engine alerts, and Sentinel rule health.
This solution installs the following scheduled analytic rule templates (disabled by default). Validate against live BowerSecurity_CL telemetry before enabling.

elements.name: analytic1
elements.label: Bower: Windows failed network logons from one address (replay-safe)

options.text:
At least 10 distinct Windows 4625 network logon failures from one source address in a
10-minute event-time bucket. Replayed Bower rows are collapsed by BowerSecurityEventsOfType
and late events are evaluated once, at first ingestion, up to 360 minutes late.

elements.name: analytic2
elements.label: Bower: repeated firewall denials from one address (replay-safe)

options.text:
At least 20 distinct firewall denials from one source address in a 10-minute event-time
bucket. Replayed Bower rows are collapsed by BowerSecurityEventsOfType and late events
are evaluated once, at first ingestion, up to 360 minutes late.

elements.name: analytic3
elements.label: Bower: events arrived later than the replay-safe rules evaluate

elements.name: analytic4
elements.label: Bower ASVS: password spraying or credential stuffing from one address

options.text:
At least 10 distinct accounts failed application sign-in from one source address in a
10-minute bucket. SuccessesAfterFailures shows sign-ins that worked from the same address.
Supports OWASP ASVS 5.0 V16.3.1 and V6.3.1.

elements.name: analytic5
elements.label: Bower ASVS: privilege, role or permission change

options.text:
A role membership, permission or privileged grant changed in an application.
Supports OWASP ASVS 5.0 V16.3.3, V8.3.2 and ASD ISM-1650.

elements.name: analytic6
elements.label: Bower ASVS: administrative action outside business hours

options.text:
A privileged or configuration action outside 07:00-19:00 on a weekday, or on a weekend,
in Australia/Sydney. Supports OWASP ASVS 5.0 V16.3.3.

elements.name: analytic7
elements.label: Bower ASVS: mass export or bulk sensitive reads by one user

options.text:
One user exported or read at least 10,000 sensitive records, or ran at least 5 exports,
in one hour. Supports OWASP ASVS 5.0 V16.3.2 and V2.4.1.

elements.name: analytic8
elements.label: Bower ASVS: application stopped sending security events

options.text:
An application that sent security events in the last 7 days has sent none for 60 minutes.
Supports OWASP ASVS 5.0 V16.4.3 and ASD ISM-1405, ISM-1906.

A Bower collector stopped sending collector_health records: collector or host down, or
delivery to Microsoft Sentinel failing. Security events from it are not arriving either.
Requires BOWER_HEALTH_RECORD_INTERVAL_SECONDS and the BWR-POL-COLLECTOR-HEALTH policy.

elements.name: analytic10
elements.label: Bower source silent at the destination

options.text:
A collector and application/environment that sent security events recently has sent none
for longer than its 60-minute allowance (firewall or WEC stopped sending, or its path to
Bower failed).
This solution installs threat-hunting, delivery reconciliation and sequence-gap queries for BowerSecurity_CL.

elements.name: hunting1
elements.label: Bower - Late events beyond detection tolerance (14-day hunt)

options.text:
Lists every Bower security event in the last 14 days that first arrived more than 360 minutes
after its event time or whose TimeGenerated Azure Monitor rewrote. Compare each hourly slot
against the beyond-tolerance analytics rule alerts to detect skipped monitoring runs and
events that require manual hunting after an outage.

elements.name: hunting2
elements.label: Bower - Delivery reconciliation (queued vs arrived events)

options.text:
Compares events queued by each Bower collector (sum of pipeline.eventsQueued from
collector_health records) against distinct EventId values ingested into BowerSecurity_CL.
Designed for outputs that cannot confirm destination arrival, such as BOWER_OUTPUT=ama-syslog.

elements.name: hunting3
elements.label: Bower - Collector health sequence gaps (post-delivery loss detection)

options.text:
Detects missing collector_health sequence numbers within each collector run (collectorStartedAt).
A gap indicates that a health record queued by Bower never reached BowerSecurity_CL, signalling
potential event loss in unacknowledged paths such as BOWER_OUTPUT=ama-syslog.

elements.name: hunting4
elements.label: Bower - Replay and duplicate delivery summary

options.text:
Counts exact distinct Bower security events against raw rows in BowerSecurity_CL per collector,
highlighting at-least-once delivery replays and extra rows collapsed by BowerSecurityEvents.

elements.name: hunting5
elements.label: Bower - High-risk sensitive data and secret redaction findings

options.text:
Hunts for sensitive_data_detected events emitted by Bower's Privacy & Secret Protection Engine
when regulated Australian identifiers (TFN, Medicare, IHI, ABN/ACN), payment cards, credentials
or cryptographic material are detected and redacted before persistence. Only metadata is
recorded; original sensitive values are never stored or forwarded.

elements.name: hunting6
elements.label: Bower - Sentinel rule health and alert visibility latency

options.text:
Checks failed Bower analytics rule executions in SentinelHealth and measures SecurityAlert
queryability lag against the alert-visibility budget assumed by replay-safe catch-up slots.
Requires Sentinel auditing and health monitoring to be enabled on the workspace.
